In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, while the low energy effective description is valid for the adiabatic perturbations during and after the turn, it fails to capture the entropic perturbations.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heavy modes do not affect the power spectrum of the adiabatic modes.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, in general, the low energy effective description is not valid during the turn.
